correctness.rationale: The LCS/deletion-intersection equivalence is exact at length six. All 203 equality partitions of six variables are traversed by supplied complete recursive code; exactly 20,37,9 qualifying ordered distinct-pair templates use 2,3,4 letters, yielding the all-q edge polynomial via injective falling-factorial relabeling. The five degrees are affine because any neighbor uses at most one new symbol, with base values and coefficients checked by actual deletion-shadow comparison; a separate direct algorithm independently verifies all edges and degrees through q=7. A partition of vertices into q² conflict cliques, Caro–Wei bound, and constructive pair-disjoint 3-subset packing prove the capacity bounds without a conjectured exact maximum.

value.rationale: An exact uniform-in-alphabet graph census and complete degree spectrum are useful nonlocal structural data for a naturally constrained deletion channel, rather than arbitrary isolated numeric instances. The comparison of q^3 possible palindromes with optimal two-deletion code order q² yields a motivated general capacity scaling law. The theorem explicitly preserves the open exact capacity question and does not claim a physical interpretation.
